owner_decision: September 10, 2026: track official U.S. government action on the grid interface (electricity prices, interconnection, transmission siting) and on export controls for advanced computing, as grade A events from the Federal Register API (www.federalregister.gov/api/v1/, public domain, keyless). Each matching document becomes an event, never a numeric record; a quantity named inside a rule is a research question for the model, not an import. A document is published only when a reviewed anchor phrase appears in its own title or abstract: a full-text match alone (a Wyoming haze plan, an Alaska hydro permit, a combined notice of filings) told a reader nothing about the buildout, so those stay private leads.
